task: P1-27-QA-005 — the authority behind every closing value
what: Every numeric or string closing value on clean-room-evidence.md and ci-evidence.md, classified as exactly one of six classes, with the authority that decides it. scripts/ci/check-p1-27-closing-values.mjs reads this file, resolves each authority against the tree, and refuses a value that disagrees, a value nothing claims, and a value whose class does not match the region it sits in.
why: An adversarial pass falsified six hosted-CI figures on these two pages with every gate green, and measured that fewer than half the values they state were read by anything. A number on a closing page that no check consults is a decoration standing where evidence is supposed to be, and the checked numbers beside it lend it credibility it has not earned. Correcting six figures produces six figures that will be wrong again; the durable fix is the rule that no value may appear without naming its authority.
whatThisIsNot: This file does not make a hosted observation true. For HOSTED_ARTIFACT_ATTESTED the gate proves INTERNAL CONSISTENCY only — that the record names a run, a job or artefact and the exact head it describes, that nothing hosted claims local provenance, and that nothing describing another head is presented as current. The observation itself is collected externally, from the GitHub API during exact-head CI, by a reader of the run. A local validator that claimed to reproduce it would be lying about what it did.

classes.DERIVABLE_LOCAL: A command in this repository answers it. The gate runs the derivation and refuses a disagreement. Executed test totals resolve against evidence/local-run-ledger.json, which is written only by `--record` from a vitest JSON report and expires when an executable path changes; committed FLOORS resolve against the baseline that defines them, which is a definition rather than a circle.
classes.DERIVABLE_GIT: The git object database answers it — a ref, a tree listing, a diff, an ancestry. Separated from DERIVABLE_LOCAL because git answers questions about commits that are not checked out, which no filesystem walk can.
classes.HOSTED_ARTIFACT_ATTESTED: A fact about a GitHub-hosted runner. Every record names SOURCE=HOSTED_ARTIFACT, a run id, a job or artefact, the 40-character head it describes, the field and the value. A record with standing PENDING_CANDIDATE_OBSERVATION carries no value and names where the observation will come from.
classes.PROTECTED_POST_MERGE_ONLY: Produced only by a push to a protected branch. It cannot exist before the merge, so the value is null and the page states the pending status. A figure here while the merge has not been taken is refused.
classes.HISTORICAL_SUPERSEDED: True of a head this record no longer describes. Kept rather than deleted, banner-marked in the rendered page, and excluded from the current seal. Each one names the check that binds it or says why none can.
classes.NON_NORMATIVE_EXAMPLE: An illustration rather than a measurement. Excluded on the same terms.
